question: Rank the full 11-suspect slate by probability score — include the 2026 Burnett and Wilkins forensic claims as a scored input. Which suspects does the new peer-reviewed evidence move the most, and does the joint hypothesis for Carlson, Michaelson, and Lanegan change?
metric_label: 11-suspect ranked probability model · Burnett & Wilkins 2026 integrated

upstream_models.description: Burnett & Wilkins (2026) peer-reviewed forensic paper claims, ingested via Connector SDK from Euronews, Military.com, and Seattle Times 2026 coverage. Three gold-layer claims: heroin-level incapacitation argument, blood-spatter absence, organ necrosis consistent with prolonged circulatory collapse.
Suspect dimension — 11 suspects spanning baselines, primaries, secondaries, witnesses, commentators, and the John Doe unknown-assailant placeholder.
All extracted corpus claims with source_type, named_person, direction (supporting/contradicting), sworn flag, and confidence score from Cortex.
